title: Cipher and Protocol
author: Ivo Thornbury
blurb: Casper Oyelaran, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
